caption: A sheet of paper is crumpled into a tight ball and dropped on the desk.

sa.check: A sheet of paper is held.
It is crumpled into a ball.
The ball is dropped on the desk.
The ball is tight rather than loose.
The crumpling comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: The ball keeps its crumpled shape and creases after release and does not unfold flat.
pc.fail: It unfolds flat on its own; or the creases vanish; or it re-crumples by itself.

pc.expect: The sheet wrinkles and folds in on itself as it is crushed, getting smaller.
pc.fail: It stays flat under crushing; or it grows; or it tears into pieces.

pc.expect: Dropped, it falls to the desk and stays.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs.

pc.expect: The paper creases sharply and is light.
pc.fail: It is rubbery; or melts; or is a rigid plate.
The ball duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The paper's colour and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the desk changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
